name: OCRotaMember
title: OCRotaMember - Global
summary: The OCRotaMember script include provide methods to perform maintenance operations on the On-call Member [cmn_rota_member] table.

members.name: deactivateUser
members.summary: Deactivates the user's rota member records according to the deactivate date.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
userId String The sys id of the user.
deactivateDate GlideDateTime The date from which the user's rotation is deactivated.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: hasChanged
members.summary: Checks whether the cmn_rota_member record has changed. Checks the Member, From, To, and Order fields have changed.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
current GlideRecord The latest changes made to the cmn_rota_member record.
previous GlideRecord The original state of the cmn_rota_member record.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: hasOrderChanged
members.summary: On update of a cmn_rota_member record, checks whether the order of the record has changed.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
current GlideRecord The latest changes made to the cmn_rota_member record.
previous GlideRecord The original state of the cmn_rota_member record.
Returns
Type Description
Boolean Returns true if the order has changed.

members.name: recalculate
members.summary: Recalculates the schedule for the cmn_rota_member record.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
current GlideRecord The latest changes made to the cmn_rota_member record.
previous GlideRecord The original state of the cmn_rota_member record.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: validateDates
members.summary: Ensures that the From date occurs before or on the same date as the To date.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
from String Formatted date/
to String Formatted date/
Returns
Type Description
Boolean Returns true if the From date is before or on same date as To date.
